name: INV-03 - List Review Queue
purpose: Return a small review queue to the Copilot Studio agent for finance users.

trigger.action: When an agent calls the flow

actions.name: List review rows
actions.notes: Filter status = Needs Review, order by Created On ascending, Top Count = min(maxItems, 10).

actions.name: Select safe fields
actions.notes: Return invoice number, supplier, total, review reason and source URL only.

actions.name: Respond to the agent
actions.notes: Asynchronous response Off; return compact JSON/text.
